children: Investors temper expectations for Bank of England interest-rate rises in the coming months as concerns about the AI industry weigh on sentiment. Markets are now only fully pricing in two BOE rate increases in 2027, and a 49% chance of a third hike by year-end, LSEG data show. That's down from the three BOE rate increases markets were fully pricing in for 2027 at the start of this week. On Thursday, the Bank of England lifted its key interest rate to 4.0% in a widely expected decision. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
